# `passportsim nfc_tag`

Load NDEF records onto the NFC card, enable its counter or lock it, and dump it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `nfc` |
| MCP tool | `passport_nfc_tag` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/nfc_tag` |
| Scenario step | `nfc.tag` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim nfc_tag [--counter] [--dump] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--lock] [--uid <UID>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `counter` | `--counter` | `boolean` | no | Enable the NFC counter. |
| `dump` | `--dump` | `boolean` | no | Add the 45 pages. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `lock` | `--lock` | `boolean` | no | Irreversible read-only lock. |
| `ndef` | carried by `--json` | `array` | no | - |
| `uid` | `--uid <UID>` | `string` | no | Refused: seed-derived. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/nfc_tag.input.json`](../schema/commands/nfc_tag.input.json).

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/nfc_tag.output.json`](../schema/commands/nfc_tag.output.json).

## Examples

### Load a URI record and enable the NFC counter

```sh
passportsim nfc_tag --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "counter": true,
  "ndef": [
    {
      "type": "uri",
      "uri": "https://example.com/p"
    }
  ]
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "counter": true,
  "ndef": [
    {
      "type": "uri",
      "uri": "https://example.com/p"
    }
  ]
}
'@ | passportsim nfc_tag --json -
```

### Dump the card with the UID redacted

```sh
passportsim nfc_tag --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "dump": true
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "dump": true
}
'@ | passportsim nfc_tag --json -
```
